description: The Regulatory Authority of Bermuda (RA) is the multi-sector regulator for electronic communications, electricity and submarine communication cables. Its website, read on 2026-09-29, keeps an authorisation register described as a public registry of all licences, permits and other authorisations granted by the RA. The licence pages cover electricity licences (transmission, distribution and retail, bulk generation, and large-scale self-supply) and electronic communications licences (radio licences, type approvals, communications operating licences and spectrum licences), and the site also holds a service providers directory, board minutes recording decisions, media releases and a reports section with sector reports. Coverage: national, Bermuda. Format and access: free web pages on ra.bm. Licence: not stated. Caveats: the register lists authorisations, not network assets or capacities; fields and dates of the register entries were not read in detail. Simulation uses: governance and operator inputs for electricity and telecom system models of a small island system. Related records: compare with Australia's ACMA radiocommunications licence register (data-acma-register-radiocommunications-licences) and Bermuda Hospitals Board statistics (data-bermuda-hospitals-board-statistics).
